text: I went to the clinic with a lot of pain at my horsetail region. I also had buzzing and tingling sensation in my whole of my lower body. I was very lucky to get an appointment at the last minute. The doctor was so kind to do the treatment immediately. Just for my sake they closed the clinic 45mins after the closing time. I felt better with each treatment. I was very worried but the doctor reassured that it will get better. Very thankful for the doctor. 🙏🏼
Finally I found a professional Physiotherapy Clinic in Phuket !!!
